ops.title: package-install cannot upgrade a live runtime: quiesce catch-22 + exact-absence race
ops.description: Found 2026-07-27 rolling out v12.20.13 (workflow wf_4dc05729-4af rollout lane; 4 attempts, 2 reproducible failure modes). (1) Live path: internal/hookd/deployment.go runtimeQuiesce -> health.current() where current() returns h.RuntimeBuild == Build — Build is the INSTALLER's link-stamped build, so a healthy live 12.20.12 runtime can never satisfy quiesce during a 12.20.13 install: "captain package: prior runtime has the wrong generation". Every in-place upgrade on a running deployment is broken by design. (2) Cold path: the already-absent branch (deployment.go:513-523) demands zero processes at hostExecutablePath, but live session hook traffic respawns the prior generation within ~1-2s of bootout (observed: install 06:48:27-29, app respawned :28, host :29, both PPID 1) — the installer cannot get its absence window on a busy machine (~20 agents). Workaround used for this rollout: chmod 000 the deployed generation's two binaries (ExecutableIdentities compares path strings only, never reads the file), bootout, cold install, perms restored by the fresh bundle. Fix direction: quiesce should accept any healthy prior build (compare against the installed generation's own build), and/or the installer should suppress respawn for the install window.

ops.text: a live healthy prior-build runtime can be quiesced and upgraded in place (current() no longer compares prior RuntimeBuild to the installer's Build)
cold install wins against client respawn on a busy machine (absence window held or respawn suppressed during install)
